_comment: skill_tag corrections for Part 5. word_form ('詞性判斷') is only meaningful when the options differ in part of speech, so the slot's grammar decides the answer. In each item below the generated explanation asserts a part-of-speech rule ('空格修飾動詞，需用副詞') while every option already satisfies it — the rule eliminates nothing and meaning does the whole job. Tagging those as word_form sends the learner to derivational-morphology practice for a vocabulary gap. Applied by src/apply-skill-tag-patch.ts, which re-checks the shared-part-of-speech evidence before writing.
